## Whitespace contradicts operator precedence Whitespace around nested operators contradicts precedence. --- Use explicit parentheses to make the intended grouping unambiguous while preserving behavior.

Best fix in this file/region:

  • In scripts/select-pages-source.mjs, inside workflowPagesOptions where publicAllowed is computed (line 209 in the snippet), wrap the && subexpression in parentheses:
    • From: options.mode!=='release'||options.unitId && options.unitId===approvedUnit
    • To: options.mode!=='release'||(options.unitId && options.unitId===approvedUnit)

No imports, helper methods, or new definitions are needed.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused import versionsPath. --- To fix an unused named import without changing behavior, remove only the unused symbol from the import declaration and keep the rest unchanged.

In scripts/test/configuration-authority.test.mjs, update the import from ../configuration-view.mjs to remove versionsPath while retaining inspectRepository. No other code changes are required, and no runtime behavior is altered because unused imports are not part of execution logic.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused import prepareTarget. --- To fix this without changing behavior, remove prepareTarget from the named import list in scripts/test/configuration-authority.test.mjs.

Best single fix:

  • Edit the import on line 13.
  • Keep assertChannelWorkflow and trialKey.
  • Remove only prepareTarget.

No additional methods, definitions, or packages are needed.
